qualification: Original OSM only; no screenshot tracing, survey, access approval or publication. No graph patch justified automatically.

scope.extent_policy: Exact university polygon union controls each original consecutive source-node segment. Retain maximal fully covered runs without clipping or invented boundary nodes. Exclude crossing/outside pairs; all v1 access/grade/indoor guards remain. Hull is display extent, not ownership/access permission.
